split_rule: shuffle sorted IDs with Python Random(20261113), first 10 development; fixed before scoring
baseline: fixed v1 with unchanged frozen nine-game weights
labels: SkillCorner automatic phase/possession proxies; distinct from target corrected tracking GT
primary_endpoint: equal-game mean spellF1 on naturally detected tracking; confirmation report separate from known nine-game CV
development_objective: improve transition boundaries without losing robustness; evaluate only prespecified decoder and training candidates
confirmation_rule: choose at most one candidate before scoring confirmation, report all games and regressions, do not tune after results
competition_inputs: never used for model selection or quality tests
training_candidates: If decoder alone is insufficient, fit stage-one robust sensor augmentation on original nine games, compare unstacked and fixed 50/50 stage-one probability ensemble; no SkillCorner confirmation game enters training.

selection.gates: Known matched and known severe corruption no worse than v1 minus .005; SkillCorner natural no worse than v1 minus .01. Ties prefer original v1. Candidate must improve weighted score by at least .002.
selection.weights_training: No new SkillCorner game used to fit learned weights in decoder comparison
